<Wix xmlns="http://wixtoolset.org/schemas/v4/wxs">
  <Package Name="SftpSync" 
           Manufacturer="André Maillard" 
           Version="1.0.0" 
           UpgradeCode="6ba7b810-93ee-4e50-8673-e380f2b0f49a" 
           Language="1036" 
           Scope="perMachine">
    
    <MajorUpgrade DowngradeErrorMessage="Une version plus récente de [ProductName] est déjà installée." />

    <MediaTemplate EmbedCab="yes" />

    <StandardDirectory Id="ProgramFiles64Folder">
      <Directory Id="INSTALLFOLDER" Name="SftpSync" />
    </StandardDirectory>

    <StandardDirectory Id="DesktopFolder" />

    <StandardDirectory Id="ProgramMenuFolder">
      <Directory Id="ApplicationProgramsFolder" Name="SftpSync" />
    </StandardDirectory>

    <ComponentGroup Id="ProductComponents" Directory="INSTALLFOLDER">
      
      <Component Id="MainExecutable" Guid="a1b2c3d4-e5f6-47a8-99b0-11c2d3e4f5a6">
        <File Id="SftpSyncEXE" 
              Source="D:\SftpSync\SftpSync.UI\bin\Release\net10.0-windows10.0.19041.0\win-x64\publish\SftpSync.UI.exe" 
              KeyPath="yes" />
        
        <Shortcut Id="StartMenuShortcut" 
                  Directory="ApplicationProgramsFolder" 
                  Name="SftpSync" 
                  WorkingDirectory="INSTALLFOLDER" 
                  Advertise="yes" />

        <Shortcut Id="DesktopShortcut" 
                  Directory="DesktopFolder" 
                  Name="SftpSync" 
                  WorkingDirectory="INSTALLFOLDER" 
                  Advertise="yes" />
      </Component>

      <Files Include="D:\SftpSync\SftpSync.UI\bin\Release\net10.0-windows10.0.19041.0\win-x64\publish\***" />

    </ComponentGroup>

    <DirectoryRef Id="ApplicationProgramsFolder">
      <Component Id="CleanupShortcuts" Guid="7fe5c921-1402-4b24-9b11-d9bb730a4422">
        <RemoveFolder Id="CleanupShortcuts" On="uninstall" />
        <RegistryValue Root="HKCU" Key="Software\AndreMaillard\SftpSync" Name="installed" Type="integer" Value="1" KeyPath="yes" />
      </Component>
    </DirectoryRef>

    <Feature Id="MainFeature" Title="SftpSync Installation" Level="1">
      <ComponentGroupRef Id="ProductComponents" />
      <ComponentRef Id="CleanupShortcuts" />
    </Feature>
  </Package>
</Wix>
